sources.entry: Ghbdtn - Menu bar app that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (English/Russian) with an Option+Command tap: converts the selection or the last word and switches the layout.

summary.one_liner: Ghbdtn is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that fixes text typed in the wrong English/Russian keyboard layout when you tap Option+Command.
keywords: fix text typed in wrong language
summary.what_it_does: Ghbdtn runs as a menu bar app and listens for a clean Option+Command tap. If text is selected, it converts the selection; otherwise it converts the last word before the cursor, including symbols (for example "nj;t" becomes "тоже"). Conversion is per letter, so mixed-layout text is handled and letter case is preserved. After replacing text, it switches the system keyboard layout to match the script of the last converted letter. The key map is built from the layouts enabled in macOS via UCKeyTranslate, and the clipboard is restored after each conversion. When ⌘C/⌘V are unavailable, it falls back to reading and writing the text field through the Accessibility API. The README describes it as event-driven with no polling, and the menu offers Launch at login and Quit.
use_cases: fix text typed in the wrong keyboard layout on a Mac
convert a selected English-typed phrase into Russian
switch between English and Russian layouts without retyping
correct a mistyped last word before the cursor
fix mixed English and Russian text in one line
notable: Option+Command tap converts either the selection or the last word before the cursor
Per-letter conversion so mixed-script text is fixed, with case preserved
Key map built from the user's real enabled macOS layouts (ABC/U.S. and Russian/Russian – PC)
Verifies the selection with a second copy before replacing text, leaving text alone on mismatch
Restores the clipboard after each conversion
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later, one Latin and one Cyrillic layout enabled, and Accessibility permission
Not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch and needs manual approval in Privacy & Security
With ad-hoc signing (no Apple Development certificate), Accessibility permission must be granted again after each build
Only English and Russian layouts are described as supported
